claims.statement: The Vietnamese domain glossary maps Trips (Chuyến xe), Financials (Tài chính — sổ cái ledger, công nợ phải thu/trả, giấy báo nợ, phân bổ lợi nhuận), Fleet & Personnel (lái xe, khách hàng, nhà cung cấp, giao nhận/forwarder, lương sản lượng, kỷ luật), fuel & allowance, penalties & salary, and System Audit & Tracking; its authoritative term sources are the LABELS maps in shared/src/constants/index.ts and the per-feature Vietnamese manuals docs/flows/00–15 (indexed by docs/flows/README.md) — the former /CONTEXT.md glossary has been deleted.

The trip lifecycle has 5 states (pgEnum trip_status / TripStatus): Mới tạo (CREATED) → Đang chạy (IN_TRANSIT) → Hoàn thành (COMPLETED) → Đã khóa (LOCKED), plus Đã hủy (CANCELED); transitions are enforced by transitionTripStatus in backend/src/services/trip-status-machine.service.ts, which posts ledger entries when IN_TRANSIT→COMPLETED (LedgerService.postTripLock), leaves them untouched on LOCKED→COMPLETED unlock, and reverses them via postTripUnlock UNLOCK_REVERSAL rows when a COMPLETED trip is canceled.

Penalties (Kỷ luật) are salary deductions from the driver — TxnType.PENALTY debit rows on the DRIVER ledger (note 'Kỷ luật chuyến <tripCode>'), not company expenses; pnl.service sums non-CANCELED penalties as otherIncome, and Net Profit = adjustedGrossProfit (revenue − trip costs − maintenance expenses) − unassigned company expenses + otherIncome (the managementFee line is currently reported as 0).

Fuel modes are AUTO (per-leg: Σ round(km × norm / 100) using fuel_config loaded/empty norms snapshotted per trip, plus fuelConfig.supplement (default 3 L/trip) and a manual fuelSupplementLiters; when routes.fixedFuelAllowance is set it takes precedence over per-leg norms) and FLAT_RATE / Khoán (manual fuelLitersOverride wins over every norm); supplements are additive in both modes; the effective price is fuelActualUnitPrice ?? fuelPriceApplied; all of this lives in shared/src/calculations/tripTotals.ts computeTripTotals.

Road allowance (Tiền đi đường) = road_allowances.baseAmount (Tiền chuẩn, unique per Route × TrailerType) − tollsStations × road_config.tollPerStation + returnCargoBonus (when hasReturnCargo) − tollsDiscount, floored at 0; a positive tollsAddition replaces the computed base and twoPointDeliveryBonus is added for OWN trips (tollPerStation is configured road-config data, seeded at 150,000 ₫, not a fixed constant). Phí đường bộ is separate: a VehicleScheduleKind.ROAD_FEE reminder plus renewable expense categories (expense_categories.isRenewable), not part of per-trip road allowance.

Five roles exist with labels from ROLE_LABELS: Quản trị viên (ADMIN — policy row 'p, ADMIN, *, *', not a business user), Quản lý (MANAGER — the docs/flows manuals also call this role Giám đốc), Kế toán (ACCOUNTANT — trips/config/financial writes, but lifecycle transitions stay ADMIN/MANAGER-only in the status machine), Lái xe (DRIVER — driver_portal Casbin object, mobile portal), and Giao nhận (FORWARDER — forwarder_portal, with revenue/cost fields excluded from portal payloads); each role maps to Casbin rows in backend/src/casbin/policy.csv.

BILLABLE_TRIP_STATUSES = [COMPLETED, LOCKED] marks trips whose revenue has posted for debit notes and carrier payment statements (billingDocument.service.ts filters on it), while profit distribution reads LOCKED trips only (stored grossProfit, never recomputed); pnl.service currently selects COMPLETED + LOCKED trips even though the constant's comment still claims P&L is LOCKED-only — a documentation gap to recheck when touching either consumer.

The ledger's sign convention: for CUSTOMER, debit increases the outstanding receivable and credit decreases it; for DRIVER, VENDOR, FORWARDER and CARRIER, credit increases the payable and debit decreases it; each post takes a pg_advisory_xact_lock keyed by (entityType, entityId), and multi-entity postings lock targets in globally sorted order to prevent deadlocks.

All user-facing Vietnamese labels are single-sourced in shared/src/constants/index.ts LABELS maps — TRIP_STATUS_LABELS, TRIP_STATUS_COLORS, ROLE_LABELS, FUEL_MODE_LABELS, LOADING_TYPE_LABELS, PENALTY_STATUS_LABELS, CARRIER_TYPE_LABELS, SETTLEMENT_METHOD_LABELS, TRUCK_CAP_ROLE_LABELS, ADVANCE_*_STATUS_LABELS, VEHICLE_SCHEDULE_KIND/STATUS_LABELS, TIRE_STATUS_LABELS, NOTIFICATION_TYPE_LABELS (plus FORWARDER_EXPENSE_TYPE_DEFAULTS for phí chi hộ wording) — so a rename is a one-map change rendered through every UI surface.

docs/flows/README.md indexes 16 per-feature Vietnamese QA/user-manual documents (00 Overview & RBAC through 15 tire management) plus DELIVERY_TRIP_LIFECYCLE.md, claiming coverage of all 43 routes, 109 API endpoints, and all 5 roles; these manuals are the authoritative Vietnamese business documentation.

Advance settlement approval (accountant, one-shot) posts exactly one FORWARDER_SETTLEMENT debit on the FORWARDER ledger, materializes any refundAmount surplus as a new approved advance with its own FORWARDER_ADVANCE row so the remainder stays selectable for later settlements, and only trip expenses in a group the forwarder marked 'Đã kê xong' may enter a settlement.

trip_fuel_allocations rows are either CREDIT with a supplier (posting FUEL_EXPENSE to that VENDOR's ledger at lock) or CASH with no supplier — the 'Cây dầu ngoài' cash pump, which never creates vendor debt; DB CHECK constraints enforce CREDIT⇔supplier NOT NULL and CASH⇔supplier NULL, and the backend rejects saves where Σ allocated liters differs from the trip's fuel total.

Reports and salary logic resolve their date window through resolveSalaryPeriodDateRange with the order: per-month salary_periods override → global default row (default_start_day/default_end_day, seeded 25th → 24th) → calendar-month fallback; the P&L and profit distribution therefore report over salary-period windows, not calendar months.

transitionTripStatus guards: dispatch requires ADMIN/MANAGER and blocks a second IN_TRANSIT trip on the same truck (truck-scoped advisory lock against phantom-read races); completing an EXTERNAL trip requires externalPlateNumber; locking requires non-zero revenue (confirmZeroRevenue override) and the photo gate (≥1 photo, plus ≥1 CONTAINER and ≥1 SEAL when cargoTypes.requiresPhotos, confirmNoPhoto override); lost races surface as HTTP 409.

Tires (lốp xe) are tracked by immutable serial and mount on either a truck or a trailer; lifecycle transitions are install (status IN_USE + installed_at), remove (back to IN_STOCK), dispose (DISPOSED with disposal_date/reason, never reinstallable), and transfer (new vehicle/position but installed_at preserved so tire age survives the move); labels are TIRE_STATUS_LABELS Dự phòng / Đang dùng / Đã thanh lý and a fixed disposal-reason list.

vehicle_schedules are per-vehicle (TRUCK or TRAILER) reminders with kinds labeled Bảo dưỡng / Đăng kiểm / Bảo hiểm / Phí đường bộ / Hồ sơ / Khác, a remindAt ≤ dueAt CHECK, and a lifecycle ACTIVE (Đang nhắc) → COMPLETED (Đã hoàn thành) or CANCELLED (Đã hủy); the Fleet page's 'Tạo lịch' form creates them and they surface as dashboard/Fleet reminder banners.

billing_documents produce DEBIT_NOTE (Giấy báo nợ, rendered from debit_note_templates whose default title is 'GIẤY BÁO NỢ') and PAYMENT_STATEMENT (Bảng kê) per customer debitNoteMode (MONTHLY / PER_BATCH); lines come from billable trips (FREIGHT) and approved ancillary fees (SERVICE_FEE, sell side only — the buy side is intentionally outside the transport P&L), and a frozen debitNoteTemplateSnapshot keeps historical exports identical after template edits.

The FAQ knowledge base (faq_entries + knowledge_chunks, pgvector 1536-dim embeddings) answers seeded Vietnamese domain questions with zero LLM calls via a 4-stage cascade in backend/src/services/agent/faq-fast-lane.ts (exact → rule → pgvector cosine → score/margin gate) with a fail-open contract that always falls through to the LLM agent.
